templates.name: Warm Bistro
templates.tagline: Serif-led magazine warmth on paper tones, with a working menu, hours, and reservation form.
templates.best_for: Neighborhood restaurants, cafes, and bistros that want to feel personal and inviting rather than corporate. The warm paper tones and serif type suit a place with a story to tell.
templates.avoid_for: Fine-dining rooms that want to feel exclusive or nightlife-driven venues — the warm/casual register undersells a high-end tasting-menu experience.

templates.name: Modern Dark Dining
templates.tagline: Near-black canvas with gold hairlines and italic serif type, for a restaurant whose room is part of the pitch.
templates.best_for: Fine-dining and upscale restaurants where atmosphere and craft are the pitch — the dark canvas and gold accents read as exclusive and considered.
templates.avoid_for: Casual, family-friendly, or budget-focused spots — the luxury register would feel mismatched with a low-price, high-turnover concept.
